# nostr-release-kit

> Publish and verify Nostr kind 30063 release announcements for sideloaded Android apps, with pinned signer, hashes and signing-certificate checks.

## Documentation

- [Release kit overview](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-release-kit/blob/main/README.md): Publisher and verifier roles.
- [Android integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-release-kit/blob/main/docs/integrating.md): Use release verification and update handling in an app.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-release-kit): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
